name: TDD Guard
description: Enforces test-driven development in Claude Code by blocking edits that skip a failing test or over-implement, with lint-driven refactoring checks.

skills.name: Test-First Enforcement
skills.description: Blocks Claude Code from writing implementation code until a failing test exists, and explains what has to happen first.

skills.name: Minimal Implementation Check
skills.description: Rejects changes that implement more than the current failing test requires, keeping each step of the TDD cycle small.

skills.name: Lint-Driven Refactoring
skills.description: Runs your project's linting rules during the refactor phase so the agent cleans up code once the tests pass.

skills.name: Custom Validation Rules
skills.description: Applies your own TDD instructions, ignore patterns and choice of validation model to how the agent's edits are judged.
